# ZENIX POS

ZENIX POS is a private, authenticated point-of-sale and business management application.

## Public pages

- [Sign in](https://www.zenixpos.uz/login)
- [Register and start a trial](https://www.zenixpos.uz/register)

Authenticated POS, billing, inventory, customer, staff and administrator screens are not public documentation or agent APIs. This file does not provide credentials, transactional access or permissions.
